cd /workspace && cat > tmp/dev/badinputs.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, os
GOOD = json.load(open("/workspace/examples/input.json"))

def run(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                       input=raw, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

cases = []
cases.append(("empty", b""))
cases.append(("ws only", b"   \n\t "))
cases.append(("not object", b"[1,2,3]"))
cases.append(("number", b"42"))
cases.append(("string", b'"hello"'))
cases.append(("null", b"null"))
cases.append(("truncated", json.dumps(GOOD)[:-20].encode()))
cases.append(("trailing junk", json.dumps(GOOD).encode() + b" x"))
cases.append(("dup root key", b'{"version":1,"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}'))
cases.append(("nan", b'{"version":NaN}'))
cases.append(("inf", b'{"version":Infinity}'))
cases.append(("neginf", json.dumps(GOOD).replace(b'"time": 0', b'"time": -Infinity', 1) if b'"time": 0' in json.dumps(GOOD) else b'{"a": -Infinity}'))
cases.append(("float val", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": 2.0').encode()))
cases.append(("float frac", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": 1.5').encode()))
cases.append(("bool version", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"version": 1', '"version": true').encode()))
cases.append(("bool int field", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": true').encode()))
cases.append(("missing key", json.dumps({k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "model"}).encode()))
cases.append(("extra key", json.dumps(dict(GOOD, extra=1)).encode()))
cases.append(("string num", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": "2"').encode()))
cases.append(("null num", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": null').encode()))
cases.append(("BOM", b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + json.dumps(GOOD).encode()))
cases.append(("bad utf8", json.dumps(GOOD).encode()[:100] + b"\xff\xfe" + b"}" * 200))
cases.append(("single quotes", str(GOOD).encode()))
cases.append(("nan in nested", json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"draw": 0', '"draw": NaN', 1).encode()))
# duplicate key deep inside
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"length": 0', '"length": 0, "length": 0', 1)
cases.append(("dup packet key", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"service": [', '"service": [1, ', 1)
cases.append(("service wrong len", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"probability": [[65536]]', '"probability": [[65536, 1]]', 1)
cases.append(("prob wrong shape", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"time": 5', '"time": 4', 1)
cases.append(("time decrease", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"connection": "b"', '"connection": "zz"', 1)
cases.append(("unknown conn", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"id": "b"', '"id": "a"', 1)
cases.append(("dup conn id", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"id": "a"', '"id": ""', 1)
cases.append(("empty id", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"id": "a"', '"id": "' + "z" * 33 + '"', 1)
cases.append(("long id", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"split": "dev"', '"split": "test"', 1)
cases.append(("bad split", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"slot": 1', '"slot": 2', 1)
cases.append(("slot out of range", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"fallback": 0', '"fallback": 2', 1)
cases.append(("fallback out of range", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"initial_tokens": 2', '"initial_tokens": 3', 1)
cases.append(("initial>cap", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"kernel": 1', '"kernel": 3', 1)
cases.append(("kernel>window", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"kernel": 1', '"kernel": 0', 1)
cases.append(("kernel 0", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"version": 1', '"version": 2', 1)
cases.append(("version 2", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"version": 1', '"version": 1.0', 1)
cases.append(("version 1.0", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"time_edges": [0]', '"time_edges": [1]', 1)
cases.append(("time_edges not 0 first", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"count_edges": [0]', '"count_edges": []', 1)
cases.append(("count_edges empty", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"classes": 2', '"classes": 1', 1)
cases.append(("classes 1", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"classes": 2', '"classes": 9', 1)
cases.append(("classes 9", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"conv_shift": [0]', '"conv_shift": [17]', 1)
cases.append(("shift 17", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"draw": 0', '"draw": 65536', 1)
cases.append(("draw too big", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"length": 4', '"length": -1', 1)
cases.append(("length negative", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"idle_timeout": 1000', '"idle_timeout": 0', 1)
cases.append(("idle 0", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"len_quantum": 1', '"len_quantum": 0', 1)
cases.append(("quantum 0", s.encode()))
s = json.dumps(GOOD).replace('"rate_den": 2', '"rate_den": 0', 1)
cases.append(("rate_den 0", s.encode()))
# huge input
big = json.dumps(GOOD).encode()
cases.append(("oversize", b"[" + b"1," * 9000000 + b"1]"))

ok = True
for name, raw in cases:
    rc, out, err = run(raw)
    good = (rc == 0)
    try:
        val = json.loads(out.decode())
    except Exception:
        val = None
    if not (good and val == {"error": "invalid-input"}):
        ok = False
        print("FAIL", name, "rc", rc, "out", out[:200], "err", err[:300])
    else:
        print("ok  ", name, "stderr_bytes", len(err))
print("ALL OK" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
